# Parley v0.1.60

This unnotarized test beta corrects one piece of launch-review and Help
guidance for Agy host panes. There are no behaviour changes.

## Agy allow-list guidance

- The Agy reviewer note in the permission review, the same text in the
  launch review sheet, and the Help entry on Approvals told people to allow
  `command(parley)` in `~/.gemini/antigravity-cli/settings.json`. That is the
  spelling Agy's own sandbox refuses: Agy runs its commands through a login
  shell, a `.zshrc` or `.zprofile` that prepends `~/.local/bin` puts the
  runtime-neutral router ahead of Parley's runtime shim, and Agy's sandbox
  does not exec anything under `~/.local/bin`. The absolute
  `"$PARLEY_COMMAND"` form, which the protocol already names as the
  PATH-independent fallback, is admitted and is what the three texts now say
  to allow, with that reason.
- Observed on 21 September 2026 in a real Agy 1.2.7 host pane: the bare
  command was blocked once, the absolute form completed two correlated Asks
  under the required ticket policy, and the pane needed no wider workspace
  or extra permission root. Parley carries no new folder or permission.

## Validation and known limits

The change is wording only. The deterministic checks, repository scans and
the app build run again in the release workflow, which also repeats the
25-round Ghostty soak, packaging, checksums and packaged-launch verification
before publishing this beta.

Whether Agy's allow list matches the quoted absolute command as a prefix has
not been verified from Parley; the text tells you what to allow and why, and
Agy's own settings decide how it matches.

This is an ad-hoc-signed, unnotarized test beta. It does not update the stable
Sparkle feed or Homebrew cask. Follow the included installation instructions.
